summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing daily ASX buyback transaction reports tied to its existing stock repurchase program, which authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate Class A and Class B common stock. No new price, stake, or transaction terms were specified; the exhibits (99.1 and 99.2) simply reproduce disclosures furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on the dates noted. The program runs at management's discretion subject to market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investment opportunities. Watch execution pace against the $1 billion authorization and any acceleration or suspension tied to price and capital allocation priorities.
